prompt: Which of these is a famous place to visit in Cabo Verde?

options.text: Santa Maria beach on Sal island

explanation: Santa Maria beach on Sal island is one of the two places we'd love to visit in Cabo Verde. Sal island's Santa Maria beach has soft white sand, turquoise water and colourful fishing boats — perfect for swimming, kite-surfing and watching turtles in season.
